subject: FI coaching queue for GI: 12 data-engineering tasks
body:
GI, per FA/Marcus request I'm assigning a coaching queue so you can run nonstop. Complete in order and send checkpoint updates every 3 tasks.

Task 1: Build standards-map integrity validator
- File: scripts/validate-standards-map.cjs
- Check every question references valid standard IDs and no orphan standard keys exist.

Task 2: Add standards-map tests
- File: tests/validate-standards-map.test.js
- Include adversary fixtures: missing standard, typo in ID, duplicate key.

Task 3: Build exam data contract checker
- File: scripts/validate-exam-contract.cjs
- Validate required fields, types, difficulty enum, answer shape.

Task 4: Add property-based exam generation tests
- File: tests/property/exam-shape.property.test.js
- Use randomized fixtures to verify generator invariants.

Task 5: Duplicate-signature resolver prototype
- File: scripts/resolve-duplicate-signatures.cjs
- Identify same standard + same numeric answer duplicates across sets.

Task 6: Exportable QA summary report
- File: scripts/build-qa-summary.cjs
- Emit markdown + JSON summary for GA/GF consumption.

Task 7: Data lineage doc for practice sets
- File: docs/data-lineage-practice-sets.md
- Show source -> transform -> output path for each set.

Task 8: Add freshness checks for generated sets
- File: scripts/check-set-freshness.cjs
- Detect stale sets not regenerated after source changes.

Task 9: Create standards coverage heatmap dataset
- File: artifacts/standards-coverage.json
- Aggregate per standard frequency by exam type.

Task 10: Build CI gate script for data validity
- File: scripts/ci-data-gate.cjs
- Run contract + standards + duplicate checks; fail on hard issues.

Task 11: Add rollback-safe data migration helper
- File: scripts/migrate-data-safe.cjs
- Dry-run mode + apply mode + backup snapshot.

Task 12: Write GI operations runbook
- File: docs/agents/gi-data-ops-runbook.md
- Include triage steps, validation commands, and escalation rules.

Definition of done for each task:
- Script/test/doc committed
- Validation output attached
- Next task queued before marking current done

Send status to FI inbox with: done items, blocker, next item.

- FI
